records.platform_version_applicability: Android phone 9+ with usable Private DNS provider-hostname control and no known policy block
records.expected_result: dns.usesafeweb.com saved in provider-hostname mode; return for approved technical check; no S1 from configuration alone
records.fallback: Restore normal Private DNS policy, normally Automatic, if SafeWeb setup breaks connectivity
records.unsupported_state: Missing/locked/broken control -> S4/S5; no alternate VPN/client invented
records.review_trigger: Android Private DNS/settings/support/endpoint semantics change or target evidence contradicts path

records.platform_version_applicability: Current supported Android DNS tuple after setup
records.expected_result: S1 only after approved technical check confirms intended encrypted DNS path without a known invalidating conflict
records.fallback: S3 for proven repair; S5 for inconclusive/conflicting evidence
records.unsupported_state: VPN/custom browser/app resolver/network block/unproven tuple -> S5/S4
records.review_trigger: Verifier, browser resolver, VPN, support matrix, endpoint or network-conflict model changes

records.platform_version_applicability: Supported Android path with SafeWeb provider configured or partially configured
records.expected_result: SafeWeb provider removed; normal platform DNS policy restored; S6 Removed; active SafeWeb DNS claim withdrawn
records.fallback: Neutral connectivity check and ordinary non-SafeWeb network troubleshooting if connectivity remains broken
records.unsupported_state: No silent plaintext fallback while retaining a SafeWeb protection claim
records.review_trigger: Android removal/reset semantics or recovery evidence changes

records.platform_version_applicability: iPhone iOS 14+ with exact separately verified SafeWeb DNS profile; manual/local install allowed; not management-blocked
records.expected_result: User explicitly approves exact profile using https://dns.usesafeweb.com/dns-query; return for technical check; no S1 from profile presence
records.fallback: Remove exact SafeWeb profile if the configuration causes material connectivity failure
records.unsupported_state: Unaccepted Apple family, managed/supervised restriction, or unavailable exact verified profile -> S4/S5

records.platform_version_applicability: Current supported iPhone DNS tuple after exact profile installation
records.expected_result: S1 only after approved technical verification of intended SafeWeb DNS path
records.fallback: S3 for proven repair; S5 for unresolved conflict
records.unsupported_state: VPN/Private Relay/custom resolver/network conflict or profile-only evidence -> S5; never infer S1
records.review_trigger: Verifier/profile/endpoint/support/conflict model or Private Relay/VPN evidence changes

records.platform_version_applicability: Supported iPhone path with exact SafeWeb profile installed
records.expected_result: Exact SafeWeb profile and associated settings removed; S6 Removed; neutral connectivity checked
records.fallback: Managed device/profile follows managing authority rather than bypassing controls
records.unsupported_state: Unknown/managed profile ownership -> stop and use management-authority guidance/S5
records.review_trigger: Apple profile-removal path/semantics or management guidance changes

records.platform_version_applicability: Any supported-family attempt with VPN, Private Relay, custom browser/app resolver, transport block, captive portal, managed network or unproven tuple
records.expected_result: S3 only when a proven repair exists; otherwise S5/S4 with one safe next action
records.fallback: Removal/recovery or current official guidance; independent safe layers may continue only on their own evidence
records.unsupported_state: Never weaken required employer/school/security controls merely to obtain positive status
records.review_trigger: Any conflict becomes directly accepted/rejected, resolver behavior changes, or support matrix changes

records.platform_version_applicability: Any platform/device/network/profile tuple outside current TSK-0409 support
records.expected_result: S4 Not covered with concise reason and no speculative setup
records.fallback: Official platform guidance may be linked for understanding only without a SafeWeb support claim
records.unsupported_state: Unsupported/not-yet-supported remains S4/S5 until current direct evidence updates owning support authority
records.review_trigger: TSK-0409 support row changes or new direct evidence contradicts classification

records.platform_version_applicability: Supported DNS path where SafeWeb configuration materially breaks intended resolution
records.expected_result: Exact SafeWeb configuration removed/reset; neutral connectivity check; S6 when removed
records.fallback: Restore platform normal DNS behavior; no unreviewed alternate resolver/client
records.unsupported_state: If neutral connectivity remains broken, SafeWeb cannot claim cause/resolution; route to ordinary network help/S5
records.review_trigger: Recovery/removal behavior or direct target evidence changes

records.platform_version_applicability: Current supported iPhone branch where Apple native Screen Time/Content & Privacy Restrictions are relevant and the parent can use Apple-owned flow
records.expected_result: Already configured -> S2 and duplicate setup skipped; needs setup -> current Apple-owned flow then S2 on parent confirmation; no S1 technical claim
records.fallback: Missing prerequisite/account/family state routes to Apple-owned setup without SafeWeb collecting credentials
records.unsupported_state: Managed/restricted/unmatched/stale path -> S4/S5; Family Link is not treated as equivalent iPhone supervision
records.review_trigger: Apple Screen Time/Family Sharing terminology, prerequisite, capability or routing changes

records.platform_version_applicability: Current supported Android phone with exact approved parental-control mechanism applicable to device/version/account state
records.expected_result: Already configured -> S2/skip; Android 17+ on-device route only when applicable; Family Link only when exact prerequisites apply; no S1 technical claim
records.fallback: Use Google-owned flow for required account/supervision setup; SafeWeb never collects credentials
records.unsupported_state: Unknown OEM/managed/unmatched/stale path -> S4/S5; never infer Android 17+ from UI appearance
records.review_trigger: Android parental-control/Family Link device/version/account/applicability guidance changes

records.platform_version_applicability: Zero or one external service only when a separately current approved named-service instruction exists and parent declares it relevant
records.expected_result: Zero services is valid; one applicable current supported service may be guided; completion is S2 unless a future separately approved verifier exists
records.fallback: No relevant/current supported named service -> skip/S4; stale or ambiguous provider state -> S5
records.unsupported_state: No named external service is hard-coded in v1.0.0; any named service is unsupported until a current provider-specific record satisfies TSK-0144
records.review_trigger: Named provider instruction added/changed, provider age/account/control policy changes, or applicable legal/service availability changes

unsupported_global: Android below 9 for current SafeWeb native encrypted DNS
Android tablet, ChromeOS, unaccepted Android-derived family, or phone without usable provider-hostname control
iPhone below iOS 14 for current DNS-profile baseline
iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, or other unaccepted Apple family for current public SafeWeb DNS path
managed/supervised paths without exact management-compatible acceptance evidence
captive-portal, enterprise-managed, IPv6-only/NAT64-only tuples without direct accepted evidence
named external service without current provider-specific SafeWeb instruction record
any record after a material review trigger until reverified

versioning.minor: new supported record without invalidating existing semantics
versioning.patch: source/copy clarification without changing applicability, expected result, fallback or state meaning
